biggest_catch: High platform cut (15-25% of every booking, 25% when new) plus variable demand — you set your own rates but there is no fixed pay and no guaranteed jobs.
catches: PetBacker deducts a 15-25% service fee from every booking (starts at 25% for new sitters; pet training services have a fixed 35% fee).
Sitters set their own rates, so pay is variable with no guaranteed bookings; you compete for jobs and may need credits to bid on listings.
Soliciting payment outside PetBacker gets your account suspended; penalties raise your fee to 30-35%.
Must submit ID, get 3 testimonials, and pass their sitter test before approval.
Strongest in Asia/Europe markets; demand varies heavily by location.

steps: List your pet-care service on PetBacker (free).
Get at least 3 testimonials from friends on your listing profile.
Complete the Pet Sitter Introduction Test; profile is reviewed and approved in 3-7 working days.
Receive job requests, get hired, and get paid through PetBacker (15-25% fee deducted).
timing: Profile approval 3-7 working days; paid per completed booking via the platform.
